## Automated Test Requirements

- Every Logic and Integration story above has its test file present and green at HEAD. Run `npm test` three times in a row, then `npm run lint` and `npm run build`.
- **TM-021**: tests to add for AC-1 (the one-shot BLAST RADIUS hint text and once-only firing; the first tutorial step names the hold key) and for the `NO ROUTE TO THAT POINT. ORDER NOT TAKEN.` line. Until they exist and pass, TM-021 has no executed evidence.

Headless Chrome for Testing at exactly 1280×720 against `npm run dev` on port 4200. Output goes to `production/qa/evidence/sprint-011-head-2026-10-24/`, whose README names the commit.

## Entry Criteria

1. A smoke check report with PASS exists: `production/qa/smoke-2026-10-24-sprint-011.md`. **Met.**
2. The build launches without a crash. **Met** (smoke item 1).
3. All Must Have stories are `done` in `production/sprint-status.yaml`. **Met.** The six added stories are marked Complete in their files.

## Exit Criteria

- Every story in scope is PASS, PASS WITH NOTES or FAIL with a bug filed.
- R1 to R4 have run on HEAD and recorded their results.
- The TM-021 tests exist and pass.
- `npm test` is green three times in a row; lint and build pass.
- Each UI and Visual/Feel story has retained screenshots under `production/qa/evidence/`.
